title: CorpFlowAI OpenHands work packet (INACTIVE package — issue #743)
description: Schema for a work packet dispatched to an OpenHands worker. STATUS: INACTIVE — no worker currently consumes this schema. See ops/openhands/README.md and config/openhands/corpflowai-agent-instructions.md.

packet_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for this packet, e.g. 'openhands-2026-08-04-001'.

parent_issue.description: GitHub issue number this packet is dispatched from (the controlling ticket).

objective.description: One or two sentences stating exactly what a successful outcome looks like.

business_value.description: Why this work matters, in plain language a project manager can evaluate — not internal engineering jargon.

allowed_files.description: Glob patterns for the ONLY files/paths this packet may create or modify.

excluded_files.description: Glob patterns the worker must never touch even if matched by allowed_files (explicit deny takes precedence).

acceptance_tests.description: Concrete, runnable commands or checks that must pass before the packet is considered done.

expected_evidence.description: What must be captured/attached to the PR as proof of the acceptance tests actually running (e.g. command output, screenshot path, log excerpt).

protected_gates.description: Protected actions this packet does NOT authorize; the worker must escalate rather than attempt any of these.

maximum_attempts.description: How many self-correction attempts the worker may make before it must stop and escalate.

escalation_condition.description: Plain-language statement of exactly when the worker must stop and hand off to Cursor / a human (e.g. 'if any acceptance test still fails after maximum_attempts, or if a protected_gates action seems required').

branch_name.description: Git branch the worker must create and push to. Must start with 'openhands/'.

intended_agent_owner.description: Which agent this packet is assigned to. Fixed to 'openhands' in this schema; a future shared schema may broaden this to an enum of known agent owners.

collision_sensitive_paths.description: Paths another executor (Cursor, Codex Cloud, a human) may also be touching concurrently — the worker must check for conflicts before editing these and prefer to escalate rather than force a merge.

model_class.description: Which model routing tier (config/openhands/model-routing.example.yaml) this packet should use.

cost_risk_cap.description: Maximum USD this single packet may consume before the worker must stop and escalate, independent of the monthly ceiling in config/openhands/cost-policy.example.yaml.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds after which the worker must stop attempting this packet and escalate, regardless of maximum_attempts.

real_client_data_permitted.description: Whether this packet may reference real (non-synthetic) CorpFlowAI client data. Defaults to false; almost no packet should set this true.

production_mutation_permitted.description: Whether this packet may mutate any production system or data. Defaults to false.

external_action_permitted.description: Whether this packet may perform an action externally visible to a third party (e.g. sending an email, posting publicly). Defaults to false.
